Want to improve your GEO/AI Answers visibility in French? Forget Reddit.

Just finished reading <http://getmint.ai|getmint.ai>’s new study on AI visibility, it’s full of gems :point_down:

They analyzed how France’s top scale-ups show up in AI answers in both English & French, and found some interesting results (link to the full study in comments)

:one: Reddit is huge in English, but nearly absent in French.

It’s a top source in global AI answers… but barely shows up in French queries.

Confirms what we see at Weglot:

GEO strategy means understanding how 𝘦𝘢𝘤𝘩 model sees your brand in 𝘦𝘢𝘤𝘩 language.

Query fan-out? Brand monitoring? It all needs to be language-specific.

:two: Most visibility comes from the long tail.

The flashy top 10% of sources? Barely matter.

Perplexity’s #1 cited source for visibility queries in French — Appvizer — only shows up 1.3% of the time.

:three: The question changes the answer.

“Who do you recommend?” surfaces different sources than “What do you think of them?”

Perception questions bring out review sites like Trustpilot, G2, and Glassdoor.

Obvious in hindsight, but still a good reminder.

And honestly… this gives me hope.

AI visibility is fragmented, local, and dynamic.

That means smaller players can win.

The giants won’t eat the whole pie after all!

Thank you Mint & Joan for the very interesting study!

Have you ever tried mapping your AI visibility across different languages? What did you find?
